SemplicePhone was installed from a downloaded file, so Android blocks some permissions (SOS SMS, notification access) until you allow them:

1. Try to grant the permission once (this makes the option appear).\n2. Open \"App info\" below, tap ⋮ at the top right and choose \"Allow restricted settings\".\n3. Come back here and press \"Grant permissions\" again.
If the ⋮ menu is missing (some OnePlus, Oppo, Realme phones), from a computer with ADB:
The number must be saved in your contacts and use WhatsApp.

Turning the screen on goes straight to Home. Works only if the phone has no PIN, pattern or password.

Pick the closest situation: it sets tiles and options. Family members, SOS, reminders, weather and album stay. Everything can be changed afterwards.

To lock the notification shade, installs and factory reset, SemplicePhone must be the device owner. This is done once, from a computer, on a freshly reset phone with no Google account added:
After the command, accounts can be added as usual.

A family member among the SOS numbers can send the SMS \"%1$s\" to apply a configuration published on the portal right away.
Unread message badges, the \"%1$s\" SMS command and automatic SMS are not in the Google Play version. They are in the full edition (F-Droid or project website).

The \"%1$s\" SMS command and automatic updates need permissions that Android blocks for apps downloaded from the browser. They are in the full edition, installed with ADB (see the guide on the project website).
The first number is called. Everyone receives an SMS with the location.
The first number is called. Then the screen shows \"SEND LOCATION\", which opens Messages ready for all numbers.
Use the numbers of family or neighbours: Android does not let apps call emergency services directly.

Every 15 minutes the phone checks the configuration published on the server and applies it only if the signature is valid. Changes made here on the phone are replaced at the next publication.\nWhen on, the phone sends only to your server: battery level, version, reminder results, the list of installed apps (to choose tiles) and, when SOS is pressed, the location.
With SemplicePhone as device owner, updates install by themselves during the periodic check; otherwise Android asks for confirmation.
Standard edition: the update is downloaded in the browser and you confirm the installation. Settings are kept.
Download of %1$s started in the browser: when it finishes, open it and confirm the installation.
The language follows the phone\'s language. You can choose a different one just for SemplicePhone.
